# Beacon

> A free, open-source, self-hosted link-in-bio template. Zero database, zero build steps, fully config-driven.

Beacon is a premium Linktree alternative that runs entirely client-side. Edit a single `config.js` file or use the built-in visual admin dashboard to customize your profile, links, themes, and deploy — all without a backend.

## Key Facts
- License: Open source (GitHub: shazee-04/beacon)
- Price: Free forever
- Stack: HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript (no frameworks, no build tools)
- Database: None required (zero-database architecture)
- Hosting: GitHub Pages, Vercel, Netlify (one-click deploy)
- Admin: Built-in visual editor with live phone simulator, DOM-based static index.html generator, and GitHub API integration
- SEO & AI: JSON-LD schemas (ProfilePage, Person, ItemList), static meta tags, automated sitemap.xml generator

## Links
- Live Demo: https://beacon.shazee.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/shazee-04/beacon
- Documentation: https://github.com/shazee-04/beacon/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION.md

## Features
- 8 built-in theme presets + custom color system
- Parallax animated gradient mesh background
- Collapsible sublinks, expandable card grids, video/audio embeds
- Banner link tiles, custom HTML/CSS/JS injection
- Drag-and-drop visual editor with real-time phone simulator preview
- Atomic GitHub deployment from the editor pushing config.js, index.html, and sitemap.xml in a single commit
- Advanced SEO controls (Page Title, Meta Description, Language, Theme Color, Open Graph & Twitter cards)
- Separate manual export for config.js, index.html, and sitemap.xml
- Respects prefers-reduced-motion for accessibility

## Use Cases
- Developer portfolio and GitHub profile links
- Designer and artist showcase
- Social media hub (Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn bio)
- Resume and CV hosting
- Creator link directory
